actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent, multiple-testing-surviving BAP1-mutant identity signal, but its membership is confounded with tissue source site and its cross-modal coherence is weak, so it is retained only as a discovery-stage candidate with these caveats.

C0002 shows the strongest and most coherent multi-feature molecular signal (PBRM1 mutation plus consistent CNV architecture) and the best cross-modal membership support, but it is substantially confounded with site and CT acquisition characteristics, so it is retained with that caveat.

C0003 has a coherent PBRM1/VHL-depleted WXS identity with strong WXS boundary separation and no detected technical confounding, but its identity rests on a single modality, so it is retained as a discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 shows only weak, non-significant molecular trends and single-modality WXS coherence, but no technical confounding and no positive structural evidence for split or merge, so it is retained with explicit uncertainty for downstream validation.
